title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
venue_or_status: Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval 3(4); author-hosted full text
evidence_note: Inspected conceptual relevance assumptions and term-based scoring account; relevance independence is explicitly questioned by the authors.
limitation: Theory-centered monograph, not a contemporary agent or dense-retriever experiment.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion outperforms Condorcet and individual Rank Learning Methods
venue_or_status: SIGIR 2009; author-hosted full text
evidence_note: Read two-page method and TREC/LETOR experiments; fusion uses ranks rather than calibrated scores.
limitation: Historical ranking experiments; not a guarantee of evidence coverage or modern hybrid superiority.

title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
venue_or_status: NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks; full-text sections inspected through arXiv 2104.08663
evidence_note: Compared architecture findings, setup and Appendix B limitations; neural document input limited to 512 word pieces.
limitation: English textual ranking tasks, historical models; incomplete coverage of long documents, authority and recency.

title: BRIGHT: A Realistic and Challenging Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
venue_or_status: ICLR 2025; first preprint 2024; inspected arXiv v4 dated 2025-03-26
evidence_note: Inspected construction, query-reasoning findings and relevance subjectivity limitations; helpfulness can depend on shared principles.
limitation: Annotated retrieval helpfulness does not certify a complete answer or successful action.

title: Lighting the Way for BRIGHT: Reproducible Baselines with Anserini, Pyserini, and RankLLM
venue_or_status: SIGIR 2026 as recorded in author paper; first preprint 2025; v2 dated 2026-06-01
evidence_note: Inspected query weighting, corpus audit, fusion tables, generalization and limitations; BM25Q gains are dataset-dependent.
limitation: Limited reference models and benchmarks; strong individual retrievers can lose under simple fusion.

title: NevIR: Negation in Neural Information Retrieval
venue_or_status: EACL 2024; first preprint 2023
evidence_note: Inspected paired-document negation setup and architectural findings through arXiv full text.
limitation: Controlled minimal contrasts rather than unrestricted search or present-model guarantees.

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
venue_or_status: TACL 2024; first preprint 2023
evidence_note: Inspected controlled evidence-position design and two task families through arXiv full text.
limitation: Model, prompt and task-specific findings; no direct current-agent action evaluation.

title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
venue_or_status: COLM 2024; inspected arXiv v3
evidence_note: Inspected task configurations, error analysis and explicit validity/prompt-robustness limitations.
limitation: Proxy tasks lack verified correlation with realistic work; aggregate length scores hide some position effects.

title: NoLiMa: Long-Context Evaluation Beyond Literal Matching
venue_or_status: Accepted at ICML 2025 per primary arXiv record; inspected v3
evidence_note: Inspected minimally overlapping question/needle construction, ablations and revised model sample.
limitation: Constructed associative retrieval; attention explanation does not uniquely establish a causal mechanism.

title: LongBench v2: Towards Deeper Understanding and Reasoning on Realistic Long-context Multitasks
venue_or_status: ACL 2025; full-text selected sections through arXiv 2412.15204
evidence_note: Inspected task collection, no-context comparison and limitations; 503 English multiple-choice questions.
limitation: Uneven task-length distributions and limited sample; comprehension is not operational action success.

title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
venue_or_status: ICLR 2025; first preprint 2024
evidence_note: Inspected formal definition, 115-case human-label validation and selective-generation setup.
limitation: QA-focused, autorater-dependent; sufficiency deliberately does not imply factual truth.

title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Context Compression and Selective Augmentation
venue_or_status: ICLR 2024; selected full-text sections through arXiv 2310.04408
evidence_note: Inspected training and language-modeling versus QA experiments; optimization uses downstream task performance.
limitation: Dataset/model-dependent objectives; successful compression is not universal evidence preservation.

title: LLMLingua-2: Data Distillation for Efficient and Faithful Task-Agnostic Prompt Compression
venue_or_status: Findings of ACL 2024; full-text methods and limitations through arXiv 2403.12968
evidence_note: Inspected preserve/discard model, retained-word order, training data and out-of-domain limitations.
limitation: MeetingBank-centered training; retained original words do not guarantee unchanged semantics after deletion.

title: LongLLMLingua: Accelerating and Enhancing LLMs in Long Context Scenarios via Prompt Compression
venue_or_status: ACL 2024; first preprint 2023
evidence_note: Inspected coarse/fine selection, adaptive ratios, recovery, ablations and recompression limitations.
limitation: Query-dependent recomputation; subtle context-query relations may weaken selection.

title: Decomposed Prompting: A Modular Approach for Solving Complex Tasks
venue_or_status: ICLR 2023; first preprint 2022
evidence_note: Inspected controller/handler design, symbolic retrieval integration and subtask-error examples.
limitation: Selected few-shot tasks; decomposition and intermediate results remain fallible.

title: Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models
venue_or_status: ICLR 2023; first preprint 2022; inspected v3
evidence_note: Inspected two-stage prompting method and explicit cross-domain decomposition limitations.
limitation: Strong symbolic-task findings do not imply reliable decomposition of arbitrary agent goals.

title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
venue_or_status: EMNLP 2023; ALCE
evidence_note: Inspected evaluation setup through arXiv full text; separates fluency, answer correctness and citation support.
limitation: Automatic support judgments are estimators; support is distinct from independent source truth and causal use.

title: Correctness is not Faithfulness in Retrieval Augmented Generation Attributions
venue_or_status: ICTIR 2025; author-hosted published full text; earlier arXiv title uses RAG
evidence_note: Inspected phrase-insertion experiment and published limitations, rather than generalizing the headline rate.
limitation: One-model probe; assumes insertion does not change underlying generation processes, which requires further checking.

title: CRAG - Comprehensive RAG Benchmark
venue_or_status: NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks
evidence_note: Inspected question categories, live-system protocol and first-stage candidate-pool limitation through arXiv full text.
limitation: Fixed/mock retrieval tasks differ from unrestricted search; live comparisons use different query times.

title: FreshLLMs: Refreshing Large Language Models with Search Engine Augmentation
venue_or_status: Findings of ACL 2024; FreshQA/FreshPrompt; first preprint 2023
evidence_note: Inspected evaluation modes, evidence-order findings and maintenance/search-engine limitations.
limitation: Answers can become stale between updates; one-query Google Search setup limits generalization.
